research.label: Why quantitative finance teams are moving away from legacy tools

onboarding.q: How long does it take a fund to onboard?
onboarding.a: There is no environment to build. A desk connects its data and brokerage, brings strategies through the Laboratory or the API, and runs its first studies in the first week. Most of the calendar is the strategies themselves, not the setup.

data.q: Whose data does Fintela use, and can we bring our own?
data.a: Asset groups are built from Fintela's market data across equities, ETFs, forex and global markets. External strategies and fitness functions can read your own data sources through the API, so proprietary signals stay on your side.

closing.title: See it on your own
closing.body: Thirty minutes with the team that built the platform, on the strategies your desk actually runs.

sharing.q: Can we keep some strategies private inside the team?
